# Phase One — Chesed Boundless Brainstorm

The Awtsmoos is not confined by renderer or screen; Awtsmoos.com can let one movie covenant flow through every creative machine.

## Ideal universe
- A movie is declarative data, not hidden DOM mutations.
- AI asks one capability endpoint what can be created before generating anything.
- Any positive duration is legal if timing validates.
- Scenes may be 2D, 3D or hybrid without changing protocols.
- Characters can be 2D rigs, 3D rigs, imported media or semantic placeholders.
- Shapes include rects, ellipses, polygons, arrows, paths, patches and groups.
- Text includes titles, captions, labels, callouts, tutorial annotations and data labels.
- Infographics include bars, lines, pies, meters, counters and animated comparisons.
- Particles exist in both 2D and 3D with deterministic seeds.
- Cameras include wide, medium, close, POV, orbit, dolly, crane and overhead views.
- Keyframes address stable channels and explicit easing.
- Audio, dialogue and music remain first-class semantic data.
- Every adapter reports preserved, flattened, deferred and rejected semantics.
- Animator stays the generative/cinematic specialist.
- Nesher stays the NLE/edit/export specialist.
- Video Editor stays the fast lightweight timeline specialist.
- Mitzvah Studio stays the object/text/shape construction specialist.
- Motion-graphics/captions surfaces remain text-animation specialists.
- A mobile dock exposes intent, mode, duration, contract, import, preview and handoff.
- AI can supply structured intent or complete canonical JSON.
- A deterministic fallback compiler expands sparse structured intent without masquerading as an LLM.
- One three-minute acceptance movie exercises every major semantic kind.
- Rendering is deterministic enough that frame witnesses can be compared.
- Export validation uses measured media evidence.
- Compatibility aliases keep early prototype imports alive while new code converges.
- Canonical public time is seconds; adapters translate native milliseconds.
- Safe-area/orientation metadata makes mobile-first framing part of the movie contract.
- Future renderers join by implementing capabilities plus projection, not by forking the schema.
